entries.en: What do you want, you beautiful creature?
That is not how I see it... Yes... More personality...
entries.ro: Nu asta văd eu... Da... Mai multă personalitate...

entries.en: That is why you have me...! Wait, who...? How dare you compare me to him...? That man is a dilettante!
entries.ro: De aia mă ai pe mine...! Stai, cine...? Cum îndrăznești să mă compari cu el...? Omul ăla e un diletant!

entries.en: I am begging you...! I have so many goals...!
You wouldn't kill an artist, would you?
entries.ro: N-ai ucide un artist, nu-i așa?

entries.en: I cannot think when you're right behind me!
entries.ro: Nu pot gândi când ești chiar în spatele meu!

entries.en: Please, leave me. I need to focus.
entries.ro: Te rog, lasă-mă. Trebuie să mă concentrez.

entries.en: Absolutely...! He needs an artist's touch...
entries.ro: Absolut...! Are nevoie de atingerea unui artist...

entries.en: I wasn't exactly finished, but... very well...
entries.ro: Nu terminasem chiar, dar... foarte bine...

entries.en: Um, yes, of course. Where were we? Ah, I remember.
entries.ro: Ăă, da, sigur. Unde rămăsesem? A, da, îmi amintesc.
